title: A 2026 listed-company report stated that Hygon completed full-process Kimi K3 adaptation, deployment, and performance verification on its DCU platform
source_unit: Shenzhen Demingli Technology 2026 interim report's account of domestic AI-model and accelerator ecosystem adaptation
geography: China, Hygon DCU, Kimi K3, domestic AI-model ecosystem, and listed technology firms

observations.period: 2026 interim report published August 28, 2026; describing 2026 model and accelerator ecosystem developments

denominator.unit: Kimi K3 model adaptation pathway on Hygon DCU as described in the reporting company's ecosystem account

adaptation_status.value: Hygon Information reported as having completed full-process adaptation on its DCU platform

deployment_status.value: Hygon Information reported as having completed deployment of Kimi K3 on the DCU platform

verification_status.value: Hygon Information reported as having completed performance verification
verification_status.unit: reported verification status; benchmark values not disclosed

comparison_context.value: the same report describes parallel adaptation activity involving Ascend and Alibaba Zhenwu platforms

independent_performance.unit: no benchmark results, workload duration, throughput, energy, cost, or customer acceptance disclosed

observations.method: Review of a listed company's official interim report. The source is coded as a second-party corporate report of Hygon's model-platform adaptation, deployment, and performance-verification status. The record does not treat the statement as independent testing and does not infer that Kimi K3 displaced another accelerator.
observations.uncertainty: The report does not name the Hygon customer or deployment site, identify whether deployment was production or validation, provide performance metrics, or reproduce the verification. The statement is embedded in a broader industry discussion and may summarize company or media information rather than a filing by Hygon itself.
observations.subgroup: Hygon Information, Kimi K3 developers, Demingli and other listed technology firms, domestic AI-model developers, system integrators, and competing accelerator platforms
observations.counterinterpretation: Full-process adaptation can reduce migration friction without changing accelerator choice, performance leadership, or market share. Parallel Ascend and Zhenwu adaptation indicates a multi-platform ecosystem in which Hygon may coexist with, rather than replace, other accelerators.

related_sources.claim: Hunan's AI-supply inventory describes a mixed Ascend/Hygon Changsha center supporting named model applications.
Hygon's interim report describes DCU adaptation to more than 400 mainstream models and deployment across key industries and application scenarios.

boundary: This record establishes a reported model-specific adaptation, deployment, and performance-verification stage for Hygon DCU. It does not establish independent benchmark performance, production duration, customer acceptance, market share, substitution, or a causal effect of export controls.
